method: Primary agent manually inspected these exact original13 functional PNGs and2 pressure PNGs using view_image. Element screenshots are labeled. No image edit, mutable game diagnostics, state injection or extra game execution.

checks.observation: Actual scrolled 800x600 plan modal. Earned chain/beacon actions, locked trace, fixed close and save controls are readable. Upper cards are above this scroll position; screenshot does not pretend to show every card at once.
Actual scrolled short Edge modal. The last locked card and fixed footer are reachable; partial upper cards are deliberate scroll position.
Actual scrolled full-size plan modal. Earned cards show action, I-rank effects and costs; footer remains separate from scroll area. Prepayment introduction lies above current scroll position.
Fresh profile cards visibly show pending availability rather than active choose controls. Default remains available above scroll position. Fixed close/footer visible.
Unedited element screenshot of real paused detail card: actual bites 3, per-cell positive-damage definition, Q trigger, 6-second life, 24-damage/0.8-second bites and cost are readable.

Actual pause overlay and details entry are readable. Background HUD is intentionally blurred, so this PNG alone cannot prove its displayed count. Exact HUD/detail/metric agreement comes from the test DOM assertions at the same frozen tick.
Actual result element screenshot: treatment facts and chain/ricochet facts appear as two compact readable panels. This crop is not a complete result screen.

Actual expanded result element screenshot. Repair, organ costs, 19 accepted beacon bites, zero synergy and actual core facts remain separately labeled; chain-count definition readable. Crop does not demonstrate all modal actions.

Actual live prepared case before first XP choice. HUD says pending prepayment and bite3; squad x3, several cell bodies, source and enemy are visible. Some cell/player/enemy bodies overlap; count and real positive damage are also established by snapshot/event assertions. Not proof of every cell being individually visible on every frame.
Actual XP26 screen: prepaid choice settled, next threshold55, no draft; initial8-second preparation feedback remains visible. This is the original prepared feedback, not a new rank-up grant.
Actual later paused draft shows two new routes plus beaconII progression, explicit 24->36 damage and6->8-second lifetime. Three candidates remain one choice from four protocol routes.

Actual scrolled Chrome800x600 direction page. Diagnosed crystal direction, primary/partner guarantee,3-sample confirmation, free cancel, one details control and help are readable. Not physical Ctrl zoom.
Actual full Edge result. Treatment/control panels and next-case entry appear beneath retry/new/details actions; no clipping at1366x768. Zero-loss and no-unnecessary-claims values remain explicit.

Actual standard-effects formal pressure image manually inspected. Player at lower left, repair target, terminal, research station and minimap remain identifiable. Two visible elites and squad effects overlap near the right edge. Sampled24 enemies plus3 cells is corroborated by raw state; many enemies are outside this camera. Not24 individually visible bodies, not uninterrupted maximum density.

Actual low-effects formal pressure image manually inspected separately: organ92%, accepted bite594, player100 and current repair feedback are readable. It is a different real state from standard, not identical-state A/B. Player/repair target, facilities and minimap remain identifiable; cell circles and bodies near right-side elites partly overlap. Raw state proves24+3 coexistence, not every body visible on screen.

scope: Manual technical image inspection plus separate DOM assertions. Does not establish five-player recognition, physical Ctrl zoom, all-terrain readability or every-frame separation.
